claim: Director Robert Stevenson was from a geographically smaller country than another director. That director directed his final film Romance of Astree and Celadon.

per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  r.name AS stevenson_name, 
  r.country AS stevenson_country, 
  c1.area AS stevenson_country_area,
  d.name AS other_director_name, 
  d.country AS other_director_country, 
  c2.area AS other_director_country_area, 
  f.title AS final_film_title
FROM 
  directors r
JOIN 
  countries c1 ON r.country = c1.name
JOIN
  (
    SELECT director_id, MAX(film_date) AS last_film_date 
    FROM films 
    GROUP BY director_id
  ) lf ON lf.director_id = r.id
JOIN 
  films f ON f.director_id = lf.director_id AND f.film_date = lf.last_film_date
JOIN
  directors d ON d.name != r.name
JOIN
  countries c2 ON d.country = c2.name
JOIN
  (
    SELECT director_id, MAX(film_date) AS last_film_date 
    FROM films 
    GROUP BY director_id
  ) dlf ON dlf.director_id = d.id
JOIN 
  films film_final ON film_final.director_id = dlf.director_id AND film_final.film_date = dlf.last_film_date
WHERE 
  r.name = "Robert Stevenson" AND
  film_final.title = "Romance of Astree and Celadon" AND
  c1.area < c2.area
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  p.name AS performer_name, 
  t.title AS tv_show_title, 
  t.country AS tv_show_country, 
  h.name AS host_name, 
  h.total_shows_hosted 
FROM 
  Performers p
JOIN 
  Appearances a ON p.id = a.performer_id
JOIN
  TV_Shows t ON a.tv_show_id = t.id
JOIN
  Hosts h ON t.host_id = h.id
WHERE 
  p.name = "Paul Melba" 
  AND t.country = "United Kingdom";

SELECT 
    tv_show.name, 
    host.name, 
    COUNT(episode.id) AS total_hosted_shows 
FROM 
    tv_shows AS tv_show 
JOIN 
    appearances ON tv_show.id = appearances.show_id 
JOIN 
    people AS paul ON appearances.person_id = paul.id AND paul.name = 'Paul Melba' 
JOIN 
    hosts ON tv_show.id = hosts.show_id 
JOIN 
    people AS host ON hosts.person_id = host.id 
GROUP BY 
    tv_show.name, host.name 
HAVING 
    COUNT(episode.id) = 23;

SELECT ?host ?numShows WHERE {
  ?show rdfs:label ?showName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?showName), "british version")) .
  ?show dbo:starring dbr:Paul_Melba .
  ?show dbo:presenter ?host .
  ?host dbo:numberOfShowsHosted ?numShows .
  FILTER(?numShows = 23)
} LIMIT 10
